build_sparseconvnet_package: build the sparseconvnet Python package with CUDA or CPU extension using setuptools and torch.utils.cpp_extension
create_cuda_extension: create a CUDAExtension for sparseconvnet.SCN with cuda.cu, sparseconvnet_cuda.cpp, and pybind.cpp source files
create_cpp_extension: create a CppExtension for sparseconvnet.SCN with pybind.cpp and sparseconvnet_cpu.cpp source files for CPU-only builds
test_cuda_availability: test CUDA availability and verify matrix multiplication correctness before building the extension
build_extension_with_build_ext: build the sparseconvnet extension module using BuildExtension cmdclass from torch.utils.cpp_extension
